parsed.why: New penal code criminalises all same-sex relations; venue raids, extorted trans traveller's death in custody, official national-defense threat framing and a 2026 vigilante mob surge with no anti-discrimination remedy anywhere.

Conduct decriminalised in 2022, no trans offence or documented targeting, but discrimination lawful with no remedy, communities avoid police, and a documented port exclusion of LGBTQ visitors; thin enforcement record.

No criminalisation since 1975, senior officials endorse Pride, and 2024 decrees explicitly protect trans people and bar involuntary outing; offset by service-level verbal abuse and resident-side family violence that rarely reaches visitors.

No criminalisation and courts grant gender recognition and marriage registration, but documented frequent physical/sexual harassment of visibly trans people in public spaces, conversion therapy, and a head of government's 2026 homophobic speech with death threats.

Universal exposures in force: single-sex spaces code (Aug 2026), strip-search and custody by birth sex, ward exclusion linked to a trans patient's death; equality protections remain, but institutions enforce hostile policy with no working remedy.
